2.t: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress

3.t: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺

4.t: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—

5.t: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne

6.t: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground
6.tr: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa Wa-maa tahtas saraa

7.t: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden
7.tr: Wa-in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra Wa-akhfaa

8.t: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names
8.tr: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwa lahul asmaa'ul husnaa

9.t: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

10.t: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”
10.tr: Iz ra-aa naaran faqaala li-ahlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa

11.t: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses

12.t: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
12.tr: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa

13.t: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed

14.t: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance
14.tr: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee Wa-aqimis salaata lizikree

15.t: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts
15.tr: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsin bimaa tas'aa

16.t: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”
16.tr: Falaa yasuddannaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa

17.t: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

18.t: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”
18.tr: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa Wa-ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee Wa-liya feehaa ma-aaribu ukhraa

19.t: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

20.t: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering

21.t: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state
21.tr: Qaala khuzhaa Wa-laa ta-khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa

22.t: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign
22.tr: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa

23.t: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs

24.t: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”

25.t: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me

27.t: and remove the impediment from my tongue

28.t: so people may understand my speech

29.t: and grant me a helper from my family

32.t: and let him share my task

33.t: so that we may glorify You much

35.t: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”

36.t: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses

37.t: And surely We had shown You favour before

38.t: when We inspired your mother with this
38.tr: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa

39.t: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye
39.tr: Ani qzifeehi fit Taabooti fa-qzifeehi fil yammi fal-yul-qihil yammu bis-saahili ya'khuzhu 'aduwwul lee Wa-'aduwwul lah; Wa-alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatan minnee Wa-litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee

40.t: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses
40.tr: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa maien yakfuluhoo faraja-'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa Wa-laa tahzan; Wa-qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi Wa-fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadarien yaa-Moosa

41.t: And I have selected you for My service

42.t: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me
42.tr: Izhab anta Wa-akhooka bi-Aayaatee Wa-laa taniyaa fee zikree

43.t: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

44.t: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”
44.tr: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la-allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa

45.t: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”
45.tr: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu aien yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa

46.t: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing
46.tr: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u Wa-araa

47.t: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance
47.tr: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa-arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela Wa-laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi-Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa-laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa

48.t: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”
48.tr: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz-zaba Wa-tawalla

49.t: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

50.t: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”
50.tr: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa

51.t: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”

52.t: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”
52.tr: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee Wa-laa yansaa

53.t: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow
53.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw Wa-salaka lakum feehaa subulanw Wa-anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa-akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta

54.t: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment
54.tr: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil li-ulin nuhaa

55.t: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again
55.tr: Minhaa khalaqnaakum Wa-feehaa nu'eedukum Wa-minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa

56.t: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺
56.tr: Wa-laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz-zaba Wa-abaa

57.t: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses
57.tr: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri-janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa-Moosa

58.t: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”
58.tr: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa Wa-bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu Wa-laaa anta makaanan suwaa

59.t: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”
59.tr: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati Wa-ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa

60.t: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned
60.tr: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa

61.t: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”
61.tr: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa-yus-hitakum bi-'azaab, Wa-qad khaaba manif taraa

62.t: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately

63.t: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions
63.tr: Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani aien yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa Wa-yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa

64.t: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”
64.tr: Fa-ajmi'oo kaidakum summa' too saffaa; Wa-qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa

65.t: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”
65.tr: Qaaloo yaa-Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya Wa-immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa

66.t: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering
66.tr: Qaala bal alqoo fa-izaa hibaaluhum Wa-'isiyyuhum yukhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa

67.t: So Moses concealed fear within himself

68.t: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail
68.tr: Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa

69.t: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”
69.tr: Wa-alqi maa fee yamee-nika talqaf maa sana'oo; innamaa sana'oo kaidu saahir; Wa-laa yuflihus saahiru haisu ataa

70.t: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
70.tr: Fa-ulqiyas saharatu sujjadan qaalooo aamannaa bi-Rabbi Haaroona Wa-Moosa

71.t: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”
71.tr: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum; innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'allama-kumus sihra fala-uqatti'anna aidiyakum Wa-arjulakum min khilaafinw Wa-la-usallibannakum fee juzoo'in nakhli Wa-lata'lamunna aiyunaaa ashaddu 'azaabanw Wa-abqaa

72.t: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
72.tr: Qaaloo lan nu'siraka 'alaa maa jaaa'anaa minal baiyinaati wallazee fataranaa faqdi maaa anta qaad; innamaa taqdee haazihil hayaatad dunyaa

73.t: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”
73.tr: Innaaa aamannaa bi-Rabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa Wa-maaa akrahtanaa 'alaihi minas sihr; wallaahu khairunw Wa-abqaa

74.t: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die
74.tr: Innahoo mai ya'ti Rabbahoo mujriman fa-inna lahoo Jahannama laa yamootu feehaa Wa-laa yahyaa

75.t: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks
75.tr: Wa-main ya'tihee mu'minan qad 'amilas saalihaati fa-ulaaa'ika lahumud darajaatul 'ulaa

76.t: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves
76.tr: Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; Wa-zaalika jazaaa'u man tazakka

77.t: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”
77.tr: Wa-laqad awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakanw Wa-laa takhshaa

78.t: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them
78.tr: Fa-atba'ahum Fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal yammmi maa ghashi-yahum

79.t: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺

80.t: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails
80.tr: Yaa-Baneee Israaa'eela qad anjainaakum min 'aduw-wikum Wa-wa'adnaakum jaanibat Tooril aimana Wa-nazzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was-Salwaa

81.t: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed
81.tr: Kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum Wa-laa tatghaw feehi fa-yahilla 'alaikum ghadabee Wa-mai yahlil 'alaihi ghadabee faqad hawaa

82.t: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”
82.tr: Wa-innee la-Ghaffaarul liman taaba Wa-aamana Wa-'amila saalihan summah tadaa

83.t: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”

84.t: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”
84.tr: Qaala hum ulaaa'i 'alaaa asaree Wa-'ajiltu ilaika Rabbi litardaa

85.t: Allah responded, “We have indeed tested your people in your absence, and the Sâmiri has led them astray.”
85.tr: Qaala fa-innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika Wa-adallahumus Saamiriyy

86.t: So Moses returned to his people, furious and sorrowful. He said, “O my people! Had your Lord not made you a good promise? Has my absence been too long for you? Or have you wished for wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me?”
86.tr: Faraja'a Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa; qaala yaa-qawmi alam ya'idkum Rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa; afataala 'alaikumul 'ahdu am arattum ai yahilla 'alaikum ghadabum mir Rabbikum fa-akhlaftum maw'idee

87.t: They argued, “We did not break our promise to you of our own free will, but we were made to carry the burden of the people’s ˹golden˺ jewellery, then we threw it ˹into the fire˺, and so did the Sâmiri.”
87.tr: Qaaloo maaa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinna Wa-laakinna hummilnaaa awzaaram min zeenatil qawmi faqazafnaahaa fakazaalika alqas Saamiriyy

88.t: Then he moulded for them an idol of a calf that made a lowing sound. They said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but Moses forgot ˹where it was˺!”
88.tr: Fa-akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haazaaa ilaahukum Wa-ilaahu Moosaa fanasee

89.t: Did they not see that it did not respond to them, nor could it protect or benefit them
89.tr: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilaihim qawlanw Wa-laa yamliku lahum darranw Wa-laa naf'aa

90.t: Aaron had already warned them beforehand, “O my people! You are only being tested by this, for indeed your ˹one true˺ Lord is the Most Compassionate. So follow me and obey my orders.”
90.tr: Wa-laqad qaala lahum Haaroonu min qablu yaa-qawmi innamaa futintum bihee Wa-inna Rabbakumur Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee Wa-atee'ooo amree

91.t: They replied, “We will not cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.”
91.tr: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alaihi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilainaa Moosaa

92.t: Moses scolded ˹his brother˺, “O Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray
92.tr: Qaala Yaa-Haaroonu maa mana-'aka iz ra-aitahum dallooo

93.t: from following after me? How could you disobey my orders?”

94.t: Aaron pleaded, “O son of my mother! Do not seize me by my beard or ˹the hair of˺ my head. I really feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not observe my word.’”
94.tr: Qaala yabna'umma laa ta'khuz bi-lihyatee Wa-laa bi-ra'see innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta baina Baneee Israaa'eela Wa-lam tarqub qawlee

95.t: Moses then asked, “What did you think you were doing, O Sâmiri?”

96.t: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful ˹of dust˺ from the hoof-prints of ˹the horse of˺ the messenger-angel ˹Gabriel˺ then cast it ˹on the moulded calf˺. This is what my lower-self tempted me into.”
96.tr: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min asarir Rasooli fanabaztuhaa Wa-kazaalika sawwalat lee nafsee

97.t: Moses said, “Go away then! And for ˹the rest of your˺ life you will surely be crying, ‘Do not touch ˹me˺!’ Then you will certainly have a fate that you cannot escape. Now look at your god to which you have been devoted: we will burn it up, then scatter it in the sea completely.”
97.tr: Qaala fazhab fa-inna laka fil hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa Wa-inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafahoo wanzur ilaaa ilaahikal lazee zalta 'alaihi 'aakifaa; la-nuharriqannahoo thumma la-nansifannahoo fil yammi nasfaa

98.t: ˹Then Moses addressed his people,˺ “Your only god is Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He encompasses everything in ˹His˺ knowledge.”
98.tr: Innamaaa ilaahu-kumul laahul lazee laa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wasi'a kulla shai'in ilmaa

99.t: This is how We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ some of the stories of the past. And We have certainly granted you a Reminder from Us
99.tr: Kazaalika naqussu 'alaika min anbaaa'i maa qad sabaq; Wa-qad aatainaaka mil ladunnaa Zikraa

100.t: Whoever turns away from it will surely bear the burden ˹of sin˺ on the Day of Judgment
100.tr: Man a'rada 'anhu, fa-innahoo yahmilu Yawmal Qiyaamati wizraa

101.t: suffering its consequences forever. What an evil burden they will carry on Judgment Day
101.tr: Khaalideena feehi Wa-saaa'a lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati himlaa

102.t: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather the wicked on that Day blue-faced ˹from horror and thirst˺
102.tr: Yawma yunfakhu fissoori Wa-nahshurul mujrimeena Yawma 'izin zurqaa

103.t: They will whisper among themselves, “You stayed no more than ten days ˹on the earth˺.”

104.t: We know best what they will say—the most reasonable of them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”
104.tr: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona iz yaqoolu amsaluhum tareeqatan il labistum illaa yawmaa

105.t: And ˹if˺ they ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the mountains, ˹then˺ say, “My Lord will wipe them out completely
105.tr: Wa-yas'aloonaka 'anil jibaali faqul yansifuhaa Rabbee nasfaa

106.t: leaving the earth level and bare

107.t: with neither depressions nor elevations to be seen.”

108.t: On that Day all will follow the caller ˹for assembly˺, ˹and˺ none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed before the Most Compassionate. Only whispers will be heard
108.tr: Yawma-izien yattabi'oonad daa'iya laa 'iwaja lahoo Wa-khasha'atil aswaatu lir-Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa

109.t: On that Day no intercession will be of any benefit, except by those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are agreeable to Him
109.tr: Yawma-'izil laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu illaa man azina lahur Rahmaanu Wa-radiya lahoo qawlaa

110.t: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them, but they cannot encompass Him in ˹their˺ knowledge
110.tr: Ya'lamu maa bainaa aideehim Wa-maa khalfahum Wa-laa yuheetoona bihee 'ilmaa

111.t: And all faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. And those burdened with wrongdoing will be in loss
111.tr: Wa-'anatil wujoohu lil-Haiiyil Qaiyoomi Wa-qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa

112.t: But whoever does good and is a believer will have no fear of being wronged or denied ˹their reward˺
112.tr: Wa-main ya'mal minas saalihaati Wa-huwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmanw Wa-laa hadmaa

113.t: And so We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and varied the warnings in it, so perhaps they will shun evil or it may cause them to be mindful
113.tr: Wa-kazaalika anzalnaahu Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyanw Wa-sarrafnaa fee-hi minal wa'eedi la'allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdisu lahum zikraa

114.t: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Do not rush to recite ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran ˹O Prophet˺ before it is ˹properly˺ conveyed to you, and pray, “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”
114.tr: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; Wa-laa ta'jal bil-Quraani min qabli aien yuqdaaa ilaika wahyuhoo Wa-qur Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa

115.t: And indeed, We once made a covenant with Adam, but he forgot, and ˹so˺ We did not find determination in him
115.tr: Wa-laqad 'ahidnaaa ilaaa Aadama min qablu fanasiya Wa-lam najid lahoo 'azmaa

116.t: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who refused ˹arrogantly˺
116.tr: Wa-iz qulnaa lilma-laaa'ikatis judoo li-Aadama fasajadooo illaaa Ibleesa; abaa

117.t: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺
117.tr: Faqulnaa yaaa-Aadamu inna haazaa 'aduwwul laka Wa-lizawjika falaa yukhrijan-nakumaa minal Jannati fatashqaa

118.t: Here it is guaranteed that you will never go hungry or unclothed
118.tr: Innaa laka allaa tajoo'a feeha Wa-laa ta'raa

119.t: nor will you ˹ever˺ suffer from thirst or ˹the sun’s˺ heat.”
119.tr: Wa-annaka laa tazma'u feehaa Wa-laa tadhaa

120.t: But Satan whispered to him, saying, “O Adam! Shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that does not fade away?”
120.tr: Fa-waswasa ilaihish Shaitaanu qaala yaaa-Aadamu hal adulluka 'alaa shajaratil khuldi Wa-mulkil laa yablaa

121.t: So they both ate from the tree and then their nakedness was exposed to them, prompting them to cover themselves with leaves from Paradise. So Adam disobeyed his Lord, and ˹so˺ lost his way
121.tr: Fa-akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw-aatuhumaa Wa-tafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alaihimaa minw waraqil jannah; Wa-'asaaa Aadamu Rabbahoo faghawaa

122.t: Then his Lord chose him ˹for His grace˺, accepted his repentance, and guided him ˹rightly˺

123.t: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺
123.tr: Qaalah bita minhaa jamee'am ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww; fa-immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan famanit taba'a hudaaya falaa yadillu Wa-laa yashqaa

124.t: But whoever turns away from My Reminder will certainly have a miserable life, then We will raise them up blind on the Day of Judgment.”
124.tr: Wa-man a'rada 'an Zikree fa-inna lahoo ma'eeshatan dankanw Wa-nahshuruhoo Yawmal Qiyaamati a'maa

125.t: They will cry, “My Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, although I used to see?”
125.tr: Qaala Rabbi lima hashar-tanee a'maa Wa-qad kuntu baseeraa

126.t: Allah will respond, “It is so, just as Our revelations came to you and you neglected them, so Today you are neglected.”
126.tr: Qaala kazaalika atatka Aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa Wa-kazaalikal Yawma tunsaa

127.t: This is how We reward whoever transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of their Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting
127.tr: Wa-kazaalika najzee man asrafa Wa-lam yu'min bi-Aayaati Rabbih; Wa-la'azaabul Aakhirati ashaddu Wa-abqaa

128.t: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment
128.tr: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil li-ulin nuhaa

129.t: Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ and a term already set, their ˹instant˺ doom would have been inevitable
129.tr: Wa-law-laa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika lakaana lizaamanw Wa-'ajalun musammaa

130.t: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺
130.tr: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona Wa-sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi Wa-qabla ghuroobihaa Wa-min aanaaa'il laili fasabbih Wa-atraafan nahaari la-'allaka tardaa

131.t: Do not let your eyes crave what We have allowed some of the disbelievers to enjoy; the ˹fleeting˺ splendour of this worldly life, which We test them with. But your Lord’s provision ˹in the Hereafter˺ is far better and more lasting
131.tr: Wa-laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa ma matta'na biheee azwajam minhum zahratal hayaatid dunya linaftinahum feeh; Wa-rizqu Rabbika khairunw Wa-abqaa

132.t: Bid your people to pray, and be diligent in ˹observing˺ it. We do not ask you to provide. It is We Who provide for you. And the ultimate outcome is ˹only˺ for ˹the people of˺ righteousness
132.tr: Wa'mur ahlaka bis-Salaati wastabir 'alaihaa laa nas'aluka rizqaa; nahnu narzuquk; wal-'aaqibatu littaqwaa

133.t: They demand, “If only he could bring us a sign from his Lord!” Have they not ˹already˺ received a confirmation of what is in earlier Scriptures
133.tr: Wa-qaaloo law-laa ya'teenaa bi-aayatin mir Rabbih; awa-lam ta'tihim baiyyinatu maa fis suhufil oolaa

134.t: Had We destroyed them with a torment before this ˹Prophet came˺, they would have surely argued, “Our Lord! If only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before being humiliated and put to shame.”
134.tr: Wa-law annaaa ahlaknaahum bi-'azaabin min qablihee laqaaloo Rabbanaa law-laaa arsalta ilainaa Rasoolan fanattabi'a Aayaatika min qabli an nazilla Wa-nakhzaa

135.t: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Each ˹of us˺ is waiting, so keep waiting! You will soon know who is on the Straight Path and is ˹rightly˺ guided.”
135.tr: Qul kullum mutarabbisun fa-tarabbasoo fa-sa-ta'lamoona man Ashaabus Siraatis Sawiyyi Wa-manih tadaa
